name: claudinite-licenses

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/signing && tsc --noEmit -p packages/licensing && tsc --noEmit -p packages/polar && tsc --noEmit -p packages/github-app && tsc --noEmit -p packages/version && tsc --noEmit -p packages/http && tsc --noEmit -p workers/router && tsc --noEmit -p workers/public-key && tsc --noEmit -p workers/key && tsc --noEmit -p workers/sync && tsc --noEmit -p tools && tsc --noEmit -p db && tsc --noEmit -p spike
scripts.dry-run: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/router -c workers/router/wrangler.jsonc && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/public-key -c workers/public-key/wrangler.jsonc && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/key -c workers/key/wrangler.jsonc && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/sync -c workers/sync/wrangler.jsonc

//: @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers installs its own wrangler and miniflare until a pool release matches the root wrangler, so compatibility_date stays at a date the pool's miniflare supports.
